description: Defines the class PartialJobSpecificationAttachment in the OrangeHRM system, representing a data transfer object (DTO) for partial job specification attachments, including properties like id, filename, file type, size, and associated job title ID.

classes.name: PartialJobSpecificationAttachment
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating attributes related to job attachment details such as file information and associated job title ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing all class properties with optional parameters.

methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment file in bytes.

methods.description: Returns the associated job title ID.
